messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — found a memory leak in tokenizer-serving v2.3.1 during long-convo perf runs. OOMs on a few canary pods. Proposing hotfix v2.3.2 (small allocator fix). Need expedited approvals for a short change window: 10m canary, 30m ramp. Deploy run: https://deploy.internal/run/98765 — tagging eng-releases, sre-oncall, security.

deploy-bot: Deploy run created: run/98765. Canary policy: 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Status: awaiting approvals (eng-releases, sre-oncall, security). CI: unit+smoke passed. Logs: https://ci/internal/98765

mike: what are rollback criteria? any chance of regen drift we should worry about?

olivia: rollback plan: immediate pin to tag v2.3.1 and evict caches. If output drift observed, roll back. Commands: `rd-deploy rollback run/98765` and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/tokenizer` + `rd-cache evict tokenizer-*`. Full runbook in the PR.

leah: +1 for expedited if canary health checks are clean. Add me as approver. Need a one-line release note for release notes and customer-facing blurb. :shipit:

sanjay: security check — this is allocator bug, no config or token changes, correct? I need confirmation it's not touching auth or credentials.

olivia: correct — pure memory allocator tweak in C++ layer, no config or key rotation. I ran static scan, nothing flagged.

alex: draft release note (internal): "Fix memory leak in tokenizer under long-context workloads; reduces OOMs and improves stability for long chats." Will push to PR now.

sre-oncall: I can approve for the 10m canary window only. Conditions: auto-rollback if error rate > 0.5% or p99 latency increases by >50ms. Also monitor GC churn and pod restarts.

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: leah, sre-oncall. Remaining approvals: eng-releases, security.

maria: eng-releases here. +1 from me provided smoke wrk for 60s looks fine and release note is in PR. Please pin the version in the manifest before full rollout.

olivia: pinned manifest to v2.3.2 in repo and pushed tag. Snippet to pin: ```yaml
image: registry.redwood/tokenizer:v2.3.2
```

deploy-bot: Security approval required.

sanjay: security approves. Verified static scan and runtime sec-policy. +1.

deploy-bot: All approvals received. Starting canary: run/98765 -> canary 1%. Health checks enabled.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 10%. Health: passing. Metrics snapshot: errors 0.02%, p99 latency +12ms vs baseline, memory stable.

olivia: monitoring dashboards open (APM, infra). Will abort if GC spikes or errors > 0.5%.

mike: if canary stays green, we should notify CS and SRE on call for post-deploy watch.

deploy-bot: Canary completed. Promoting to 100%. Run/98765 -> success. Final metrics: errors 0.02%, p99 +15ms, pod restarts 0. Closing run at 1805127890.

leah: Great. Please add a short postmortem note to the PR with root cause and mitigation steps.

olivia: Will do — pushing brief RCA and follow-up tickets (allocator tests + monitoring alerts). Thanks everyone for quick approvals. :heart:
